description: Order of price writers (Android PriceWriteOrder.kt + WatchDao.updatePriceForPair / iOS PriceWriteOrder.swift + Outcome.apply(to:)). A result only takes its price if it is not older than the stored one: accepts(newTime, storedTime, now) = newTime >= storedTime, or the stored time lies more than futureToleranceMillis (1 h) ahead of now (implausible, clock set back). storedTime 0 = no price yet. Times relative to now in ms (null storedAgo = 0 = no price yet).

cases.name: newer result replaces older stored price
older result (slow single refresh after faster full refresh) is dropped
stored slightly ahead of device clock (exchange time): older result still dropped
stored exactly 1 h ahead: still plausible
stored more than 1 h ahead (clock set back): new price taken
stored a year ahead (clock was wrong): new price taken
